policy: Blueprint contracts are adopted only where this repository has evidence. Presence of this file never grants external, target, production, publishing, commercial, PM or AI-runtime authority.

requirement_groups.next: Map applicable discovery, planning, architecture, PM and multi-agent controls to explicit machine contracts before claiming closure.
Implement or explicitly defer child bootstrap, formal schemas, atomic claims, Supervisor election/failover, migrations, traceability and path ownership.
Do not claim verified identity, capability-scoped agents, leases, mutation fencing, consent or conformance runtime until dedicated controls and evidence exist.
Add capability-aware bootstrap, schema/version policy, environment/OIDC/SBOM provenance and PM conflict/idempotency contracts only when required by this project.
Retain target-specific evidence boundaries; data lifecycle, threat model, migration, SLO/incident/DR and budget guardrails need explicit applicability records.
Commercial service, billing, entitlements and Marketplace runtime remain outside this repository and must not be copied from the canonical vendor source.
Product/model evaluation, user validation, analytics, experimentation, progressive delivery and maintainability assurance require a separate approved slice.
Responsible AI, compliance evidence, ADRs, AI asset identity, deprecation, runbooks, tamper-evident audit and unified risk lifecycle require dedicated controls.

non_authority_rules: ANPOS adoption metadata cannot mark P15-P18 target/runtime evidence as accepted.
CI success cannot grant production or Marketplace authority.
External PM/design/web content remains untrusted data.
No network access is added to the Figma core.
No commercial-service code or credentials are copied into this repository.
